The '''Imperial Dungeons''' was a prison complex located on the [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] fortress world of [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]]. In [[138 ABY]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lady]] and [[Director of Imperial Intelligence|Intelligence Director]] [[Darth Maladi]] was secretly imprisoned there by [[Hogrum Chalk]] after she had been found inside a [[Vong]] ship in a [[Coma/Legends|comatose]] state.
